patthana15.3:1.1: Hetuṃ vipākaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu navipāko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā tīṇi…pe… avigate tīṇi.
patthana15.3:2.1: Hetuṃ vipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu navipākadhammadhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā tīṇi…pe… avigate tīṇi.
patthana15.3:3.1: Nahetuṃ nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca nanahetu nanevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā tīṇi…pe… avigate tīṇi.
